name: Chitalwana–Dhorimanna National Highway
significance: NH 925A is a branch of NH 925. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Chitalwana to Dhorimanna, and it meets NH 925 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 925 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Chitalwana to Gadra Road
